description: Compare a whole-plasmid sequencing CONSENSUS (the single circular FASTA a nanopore plasmid service returns) against the design it was supposed to be, and say whether they are the same molecule. Finds the rotation and strand itself — an assembler starts the circle wherever it landed and half the time returns the reverse complement, so the two almost never line up as written — then reports every difference in the DESIGN's own coordinates. Each difference carries the length of the identical-base run it sits in, because a 1 bp indel inside a homopolymer is both the commonest long-read basecalling artefact and what a real slippage mutation looks like, and a bare difference list cannot tell them apart. Pass the design as an annotated GenBank record and every difference is also read against its features: silent, missense with the codon number, or a premature stop. Complements sequencing_readback_verify, which aligns raw READS through minimap2; this one needs no reads and no sidecar.

circular.description: Treat both as circular (the default, and right for a plasmid). The consensus is then rotated and, if needed, reverse-complemented into the design's frame before anything is compared. Turn it off only for a linear product, where the ends are meaningful.

consensus.description: The assembled consensus from the sequencing service, raw or FASTA. One record.

design.description: What you meant to build: raw bases, FASTA, or your annotated GenBank record. An annotated record is what turns a position into a consequence.

maxReadsPerStack.description: Most reads drawn in each pileup window in the `reads` block. The window itself is 30 bases either side of the difference. Each window costs roughly 60 × this many characters in the response, which is why it is bounded and echoed back.

reads.description: Optional raw reads (FASTQ-style {name, seq} objects) for the SAME sample as `consensus`. When supplied, one request also aligns them to the design and returns a compact `reads` block: per-difference support split by strand, split-read structural variants, and a small pileup window at every difference. Omit it and the result is exactly what it was before. A dev machine with no minimap2 still gets the comparison — the reads block then says why it is missing.

name.description: Read name; made unique if it repeats.

name: whole_plasmid_verify
title: Whole-plasmid sequencing: consensus vs design
